how: Irish dance (claquettes irlandaises) lessons are offered by private teachers in Paris and the Association irlandaise de Paris runs ceili dance events.
City of Paris Paris Anim' centres run weekly adult beginner tap (claquettes) classes, e.g. Thursday evenings at Centre Paris Anim' Arras.
Paris tea schools and shops run Japanese tea ceremony (chanoyu) demonstrations with hands-on bowl preparation, e.g. Takamatsu Somi sessions and Maison Jugetsudo sencha workshops.
Association Art Levant runs an ikebana workshop in Paris 12e for beginners and advanced students; Manako Jafas Paris is the local ikebana association (listing dated 2016).
La Beer Fabrique and Brew Unique run hands-on beer brewing workshops in central Paris where participants brew their own batch with a professional brewer.
A Paris 6e workshop listed on Cap Adrenaline lets participants roast their own batch with a master roaster and take home about 200 g.
Tsunagari Taiko Center runs weekly Japanese taiko drum classes and weekend workshops for beginners in Paris 11e.
Private tabla teachers give lessons in Paris (18e, 14e) and online, for all levels at roughly EUR 25 per lesson.
Sake tasting workshops with an expert run at the Caves du Louvre (7 sakes with food pairings) and at a Paris 16e venue via Funbooker.
A baker in Paris 12e runs a 2.5-hour sourdough bread workshop (rue Montgallet) where participants shape and bake loaves and take them home.

how: Mama Ly in Vincennes runs 2 to 2.5-hour dumpling and dim sum cooking workshops; Chefsquare Bastille offers a Hong Kong menu class.
The Goethe-Institut Paris (av. d'Iena) runs German courses from A1 for adults, teens and children, in person and online.
Specialist shops such as MEiSiA (Paris 10e) host Pokemon TCG events and tournaments, and the Royaume du TCG convention is held at Paris Nord Villepinte.

how: Pokemon TCG tournaments run at partner shops such as MEiSiA (Paris 10e) and at the Royaume du TCG convention; Magic-specific shop events were not confirmed.
Magic Mahjong Social Pung, a Paris club founded in 2005, runs introductory sessions on MCR and Riichi rules and informal play twice a week; Tri Nitro Tiles meets in Paris 8e.
JeVeuxAider.gouv.fr lists thousands of volunteer missions in Paris (Secours populaire, Serve the City Paris, Protection civile Paris Seine and others).
La Paillasse is an open community lab in Paris where members with a project get keys for self-service experimentation; TMP Lab is an older Paris hacker group (source article undated).
Sorbonne Universite continuing education runs a 14-hour introduction to digital electronics and Arduino programming at its FabLab on the Jussieu campus.
Paris hosts frequent hackathons, e.g. Adopt AI Hackathons at the Grand Palais (Dec 2026) and the InnovHer women's health hackathon (Nov 2026).
Student cybersecurity associations in the Paris area run CTF competitions, e.g. DaVinciCTF (Pole Leonard de Vinci, La Defense) and the 404 CTF by HackademINT and Telecom SudParis.
Lion dance groups perform around Chinese New Year in Paris 13e and Belleville and in suburbs such as Aubervilliers and Noisy-le-Grand, per the national intangible heritage inventory.
SPA shelters near Paris (e.g. Gennevilliers) and associations such as Reves de Chiens (Viry-Chatillon) recruit volunteers; the SPA also seeks volunteer investigators in Paris.
Team Trail Paris (18e) holds three themed training sessions a week plus a monthly long run outside Paris; Trail in Paris trains Wednesdays below Montmartre.
Hundreds of geocaches sit around Paris (e.g. the Eiffel TB Palace cache) and the club Les Geofranciliens organises events across Ile-de-France.
The Paris Quiz Mistress runs English-language pub quiz nights in Paris, and an expat trivia night is listed on Wednesdays at La Pomme d'Eve.
The Atelier cinema ENAC (City of Paris) is a weekly adult course from screenwriting to shooting a short film, open to beginners, September to June.
City-listed theatre schools such as La Fabrique du Comedien (Paris 1er) run weekly adult acting classes for beginners and experienced actors with end-of-year performances.
Orchestre Impromptu, a Paris-area amateur symphony orchestra founded in 1994, accepts musicians without audition and rehearses Thursday evenings; Paris has about ten amateur orchestras.
Paris card clubs such as Club Pierre Charron (8e), Club Circus (16e) and Cercle Clichy Montmartre run regular poker tournaments including free-entry freerolls.
Paris municipal arrondissement music academies and private teachers give harp lessons (Celtic or pedal harp) to adults.
